prompt_md: Two fathers and two sons go fishing. Each catches exactly one fish, and they catch three fish in total. How many people went fishing?
prompt_short: Two fathers, two sons, three fish, one each. How many people?
hint_md: Can one person be both a father and a son?
explain_intuition_md: Two plus two says four, but the middle person is both a father and a son. A grandfather, his son and his grandson make two fathers and two sons with only three people.
explain_math_md: Fathers: grandfather and father. Sons: father and grandson. People: $3$.
